 FPL Price Changes: Konsa Rises to £4.9m, Saka Falls to £9.4m (15 November)
 Konsa has risen to £4.9m, a new riser on the Gameweek 10 board, which now stands at 16 risers and 47 fallers ahead of the GW11 deadline on 21 November.
 AR Arjun Rao 
 Sun 15 Nov 2026, 06:15 GMT 3 min read 
 Updated 07:10, 15 Nov GMT Comment 
 FPL Gameweek 10 Prices Review 
 FPL Premier League 
 Photo: Bryan Berlin / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 
 Konsa is the new name on the Gameweek 10 price board since Wednesday. The Arsenal defender has gone up £0.1m to £4.9m, and on form he’s the pick of this FPL price changes round-up. Official FPL data read at 06:11 UK time on Sunday 15 November has 16 risers and 47 fallers, against 15 and 43 on Wednesday.
 Earlier boards: Dewsbury-Hall, Verbruggen Rise (11 November) , 42 Fallers, Jackson and Barry Top Buys (10 November) and Isak, Van Hecke Rise as João Pedro Falls (9 November) .
 Konsa at £4.9m is the cheap Arsenal route
 Konsa is owned by 24.7% of managers, so he’s no differential, and 148,866 have bought him this gameweek against 13,555 who sold. He has 57 points, five clean sheets in 731 minutes and a form figure of 10.2, the highest of any defender on the riser list. Gabriel (£8.1m, form 9.8, seven clean sheets) rose alongside him, and Rice (£7.5m) is up as well.

 The same data has Arsenal at Newcastle on Saturday 21 November at 17:30 UK time, which the FPL app rates 3 for them, and then City at home, rated 4. That’s not a soft run. If you want an Arsenal defender, though, Konsa is the cheaper route to Arsenal clean sheets, at £3.2m less than Gabriel. He also sits among the Arsenal options in the Gameweek 11 defenders page.

 Jackson, Evanilson and Barry stay the buys
 Nothing has changed at the top. N.Jackson (332,427 in), Evanilson (228,913) and Barry (217,245) are still the three most bought players, and all three have already moved. Brighton supply five of the 16 risers, which is the biggest single-club group. All 16 moves are £0.1m.

 Fallers: Gvardiol and João Pedro still draining
 João Pedro (£7.6m, thigh injury, unknown return date) has 335,503 transfers out and Gvardiol (£5.6m, 75% chance of playing) 306,059. Calvert-Lewin is the first faller with no flag, down to £6.0m with form of 3.8 and 124,419 out. Saka (£9.4m, thigh, unknown return date) is down too, but only 5.4% of managers still own him. The shortlist of who to move on is in the Gameweek 11 sell list .

 Guéhi (£6.0m, 75% chance of playing) has 153,370 transfers out and Thiago (£7.8m, listed as suspended until 5 December) 110,193, and neither has dropped yet. Mbeumo (£7.9m) has 86,112 out. On the transfer numbers those three look like the likeliest next movers. That’s our estimate, not a prediction the game publishes.
 Read next Arsenal Arsenal News Today: Rice Contract Close, White Booed and Saka Out (15 November) 
 There’s no rush on any of it. The Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 November at 11:00 UK time and no Premier League games are played before it, so there’s time to wait for the fitness news on Guéhi and Gvardiol. The transfer targets and budget picks cover where the money goes next.
 The picks are our own reading of official FPL data, and none of them is a guarantee of points.
